# Kept

> Kept is business-management software for Australian service and trade businesses - quotes, jobs, scheduling, invoicing, payments and basic tax, in one app. It launches supporting lawn care, cleaning, pressure washing and handyman work in depth, with over 20 other trades selectable. AU-native GST/BAS and mileage tools are built in, not bolted on.

Every business starts on a permanent Free plan (no card required, capped at 15 clients and 15 jobs/quotes a month). Paid plans are priced by team size, not per seat: Solo $35/mo (1 person), Crew $69/mo (2-4 people), Team $119/mo (5-10 people, adds route optimisation), Operation $229/mo (11+ people, adds multi-task projects). All prices in AUD + GST.

Client-side encryption: most business data (clients, jobs, quotes, invoices, notes) is encrypted on the business's own device before it ever reaches Kept's servers - Kept cannot read it.
